description: Draw a license plate as an image (PNG shown inline, plus SVG/PNG links) exactly as openvan.camp renders it. custom=true draws any text, e.g. a name, in the plate layout.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. RU.

custom.description: Draw any text (e.g. a name) in the plate layout instead of requiring a real format.

number.description: Plate number without the region, or any text with custom=true.

region.description: Region code if the country shows one.

name: get_license_plate_image
title: License Plate Image
